member.name: T:Tessera.TesseraApp
member.summary: Defines the state, message handling, and screen composition contract for a Tessera application.
member.remarks: The runtime calls once before the first render, for application-level messages, and whenever the screen must be re-rendered. Input routes through focused controls first. and always continue to even when a control handles them. Handled pointer/paste messages can be swallowed by controls. Use for global hotkeys, when a control event should flow back through the application message pipeline, and when app logic needs to trigger runtime work directly.
